summary.text: Carl Newton is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 58 since 2016 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Newton first took office on November 23, 2016, after the 2016 general election for the District 58 seat, in which incumbent Jeff Hickman did not seek re-election and Newton ran unopposed.

Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as the Appropriations and Budget Committee, the Select Committee to Review Mental Health Finances, and the Health and Human Services Oversight Committee, which he chairs.
Ballotpedia lists Albert Borrie, a Democrat, as his opponent in the November 3, 2026 general election.
